subject: Post-call: Executive recap, procurement contacts, and open risks (SaaSHealth)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Turner <emily.turner@saashealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: it-support@saashealth.com
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Executive recap, procurement contacts, and open risks (SaaSHealth)

Thanks again for your time this morning, Emily — quick synthesis from our exec-level conversation and suggested next steps so we have a single reference for internal and procurement stakeholders.

Key business outcomes SaaSHealth is targeting:
- Reduce inference cost per patient interaction by ~45% vs their current hosted provider while maintaining response latency under 300ms P95 for chat flows.
- Achieve deterministic SLA for peak daytime volumes (expected 400 rps soft peak; 1200 rps burst).
- Centralize audit logs and retention to meet your 7-year retention requirement for clinical-support interactions.

Top pain points we heard:
1) Unpredictable token spend and billing spikes during monthly cohort runs.
2) Occasional latency / timeouts from current vendor under burst, causing degraded user experience.
3) Compliance gap: procurement needs SOC 2 attestation and a clear data retention path for PHI-adjacent logs.

Risk/crunch items to flag to leadership (for sponsor visibility):
- SOC 2 evidence & logging configuration are gating items for your security committee — they asked for a summary and sample logs before April 21.
- Contracting timeline: your procurement team indicated a hard freeze on new vendors at the end of May for Q3 budget cadence. We should aim to present commercial terms to Jay (procurement) by 5/12 to hit that window.
- Integration: SSO + SCIM and a limited test environment in your VPC will be required for the pilot; IT has asked for an architectural diagram and expected network rules.

Recommended immediate actions (owner / ETA):
- Redwood: Deliver SOC 2 summary + sample audit log snippet (Marissa) — ETA 2026-04-09 EOD.
- Redwood: One-pager for executive sponsor that maps outcomes to metrics and potential ROI (Vivek) — ETA 2026-04-08 noon PT.
- SaaSHealth: Introduce procurement contact (Jay) and confirm target procurement deadline (Emily) — requested today.

Proposed near-term plan:
1) Share the SOC 2 summary and the one-pager (this week).
2) Schedule a 30-min procurement scoping call with Jay + our legal ops to align on payment terms and SLAs (target week of 4/19).
3) Kick off pilot SOW for a 6-week technical validation (deliverables: latency report, cost delta analysis, audit log export) — draft to be shared by Marissa by 4/12.

Please reply with any edits to the summary below — Emily, if you can confirm Jay as procurement and whether the 5/12 internal date is achievable, that will help us prioritize.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0178
redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-exec-onepager.pdf (1 page - exec summary)

Subject: Re: Post-call: Executive recap, procurement contacts, and open risks (SaaSHealth)

Vivek — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few things from our side: we are comfortable with the outcomes you listed.

Procurement: looped in Jay from ProcureCo (copied). Jay, we expect the procurement review to start mid-May; our finance lead will want a ballpark for committed monthly costs in order to inform internal budgeting. Can Redwood provide a representative committed-pricing example for the pilot (monthly commit + overage) and an example SLA?

Security: IT will review SOC 2 material and sample logs — we expect questions about retention windows and encryption-at-rest details. Our deadlines are tight: security wants the initial files by 4/16 to have enough time before the 4/21 security committee review.

Next steps from our side: I will confirm with finance and aim to have a target procurement decision date by 5/12; if anything shifts I’ll flag immediately.

—Emily
Emily Turner
Chief Product Officer | SaaSHealth
emily.turner@saashealth.com
